intent: A subagent_start call that names a custom agent takes only task and title; the definition's model, thinking, tools and isolation always apply. A call that also sets one of them fails in RunManager.start before anything is created (no run, spawn entry, run file, worktree or classifier request). A tasks call checks every entry before any starts and starts nothing when an entry breaks the rule, listing each as tasks[n]. Inline runs keep call values. The start schema lists agent first, then title and task, and marks model, thinking, tools and isolation as inline-only when agents are loaded. Docs, skill text and changelog match.

findings.summary: The change makes the Auto model section false (reference.md:140, untouched): a disallowed tier model 'fails the start, so the main agent can name a model instead'. For an agent whose definition sets model: auto, agentSettingsProblem now rejects any call model, so the main agent cannot name one. Limit that sentence to inline runs; for agents, point to the definition or Auto tiers.
findings.resolution: reference.md Auto model paragraph: limit 'name a model instead' to inline runs; agent runs take the model from the definition, and a disallowed tier model points to Auto tiers.
